rows.commentary: 3.5: Jasper Davidson pitches it up and Ravindu Fernando launches it cleanly over long-off for a maximum.
3.6: Jasper Davidson strikes immediately after as Ravindu Fernando plays all around a straight one and loses his stumps, departing for six.
4.1: Lyle Robertson drops short and Sachitha Jayatilake punishes it with a massive pull over deep mid-wicket for six.
4.2: Lyle Robertson overcorrects and Sachitha Jayatilake lofts it effortlessly down the ground all the way over long-off.
4.3: Lyle Robertson finds the pads as Sachitha Jayatilake scrambles a single via leg byes down to short third man.
4.4: Lyle Robertson strays into the pads and Muditha Lakshan dispatches it with a vicious flick over deep square leg for six.
4.5: Lyle Robertson attacks the same line and Muditha Lakshan repeats the treatment, depositing another six over deep square leg.
4.6: Lyle Robertson attempts a wider delivery but Muditha Lakshan steers it deftly past the keeper down to third man for four.
5.1: Jasper Davidson errs in line and Sachitha Jayatilake guides it finely past the fielder into the third man boundary.
5.2: No run for Sachitha Jayatilake off Jasper Davidson.
5.3: Jasper Davidson offers width and Sachitha Jayatilake extends his arms to drive it imperiously over deep extra cover for six.
5.4: Jasper Davidson keeps it tight as Sachitha Jayatilake nudges it defensively toward silly mid-off to pinch a single.
5.5: Michael Leask tosses it up and Muditha Lakshan dances down the track to launch it straight over long-on for six.
5.6: Michael Leask tosses it up to Muditha Lakshan, who launches it cleanly over third man for a maximum.
Muditha Lakshan smashes consecutive sixes to finish in style, sealing the victory with 28 runs off just 5 balls!
